prompts.commonRoom: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide illustrated location background for the Korean literary fantasy game Reverse Call. A former railway night-shift common room now used as a mercenary house, just before dawn. Rain on tall windows overlooking a contemporary city with distant impossible cathedral bridges, subdued violet outside. Inside: a long scarred wooden dining table, several mismatched mugs, a chipped blue enamel cup with its handle carefully glued, a kettle still steaming, a chair pulled out for an absent person, folded cloth and a logbook with NO legible writing. Amber desk lamp and restrained blue predawn light. The room feels lived in and quiet after an exhausting rescue, intimate, melancholy, hopeful. No people. Sophisticated coherent 2D anime environment illustration with delicate painterly materials, cinematic depth; no 3D render or photograph. Landscape 1536x1024. Midground table and windows are the focal points, bottom quarter calm and dark for live DOM story text. No labels, lettering, logos, UI, ornamental borders, glowing symbols, excessive particles.
prompts.archive: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide illustrated story scene background for Reverse Call. A lost-property archive underneath an abandoned railway station that is partly erased from history. Tall shelves with plain unlettered luggage tags, stacked suitcases, an old clock with hands stopped but no numerals in close focus. A long dark wood counter, two small plain railway ticket halves under a warm brass desk lamp. At the far right, an open service doorway reveals a violet mist and the side of a silent train. Rainwater ripples across black stone floor, shelving subtly incomplete at its far ends, believable architecture. No people. Refined 2D anime environment art with delicate painterly lighting, midnight indigo, smoke gray, small restrained amber lights, suspense without horror. Landscape 1536x1024. Clear quiet middle composition, dark calm lower quarter for live story text. No writing, no UI, no runes, no ornate frame, no logo.
